constraints.ocl:
context Reservation
inv: self.isConfirmed implies self.vehicle <> null

context Rental
inv: self.isCompleted implies self.payment <> null

context Reservation
inv: (self.vehicle.branch = self.branch) and (self.createdAt.size() >= 4 implies self.createdAt.substring(1, 4) = 'AB')

context Branch
inv: (self.reservations->select(x | x.estimatedCost <= 50)->size() >= 1) and (self.monthlyRevenue <> null)

context Vehicle
inv: ((self.rentals->collect(x | x.fuelCharge)->notEmpty()) and (self.category.size() <= 68)) and (self.isAvailable = true)

context Branch
inv: ((self.rentals->any(x | x.depositPaid > 5) <> null) and (self.name.indexOf('test') >= 0)) and (self.isOpen = true)

context Customer
inv: (self.rentals->exists(x | x.fuelCharge > 0)) and (self.isPremium = true)

context Branch
inv: self.vehicleCount <= self.staffCount and self.staffCount <= self.capacity

context Branch
inv: self.capacity <= self.vehicleCount and self.vehicleCount <= self.staffCount

context Rental
inv: self.lateFee <= self.depositPaid and self.depositPaid <= self.fuelCharge

context Payment
inv: (if self.amount > self.discount then self.amount else self.discount endif > 18) and (self.isProcessed)

context Branch
inv: self.longitude >= 6 and self.longitude <= 100

context Branch
inv: self.rentals->size() >= 1 and self.rentals->size() <= 2

context Rental
inv: self.fuelCharge <= self.totalAmount and self.totalAmount <= self.lateFee

context Rental
inv: (self.mileageStart mod 2 = 0) and ((self.mileageStart <> null) = (self.mileageEnd <> null))

context Payment
inv: self.discount <> null and self.amount <> null

context Branch
inv: self.staffCount <> null implies self.capacity <> null

context Payment
inv: self.discount <> null implies self.amount <> null

context Rental
inv: self.totalAmount <> null implies self.fuelCharge <> null

context Customer
inv: self.depositAmount <> null implies self.balance <> null

context Payment
inv: self.amount <> null and self.tax <> null

context Branch
inv: self.vehicleCount <> null implies self.capacity <> null

context Branch
inv: (self.vehicles->forAll(x | x.mileage < 50)) and (self.capacity <> null implies self.staffCount <> null)
